+
+/****************************************************************************
+ * Included Files
+ ****************************************************************************/
+
+#include <nuttx/config.h>
+
+#include <stdbool.h>
+#include <stdint.h>
+
+#include <nuttx/debug.h>
+#include <nuttx/irq.h>
+#include <nuttx/arch.h>
+#include <nuttx/i2c/i2c_master.h>
+#include <nuttx/input/gt9xx.h>
+
+#include "s6_gpio.h"
+
+/****************************************************************************
+ * Pre-processor Definitions
+ ****************************************************************************/
+
+/* Goodix GT911 on the ATK-MD0550 panel, wired per the J6 LCD connector:
+ *   GPIOA_0  I2C0 SDA (3.3V pull-up)
+ *   GPIOA_1  I2C0 SCL (3.3V pull-up)
+ *   GPIOA_9  touch reset, active low
+ *   GPIOA_10 touch interrupt
+ */
+
+#define CTP_I2C_ADDR         0x5d
+
+#define CTP_RST_PIN          9
+#define CTP_INT_PIN          10
+
+#define CTP_INT_GPIO         S6_GPIOA(CTP_INT_PIN)
+#define CTP_INT_CHANNEL      0
+
+#define CTP_IRQ              S6_GPIOINT_IRQ(CTP_INT_CHANNEL)
+
+/* Reset timing from the Goodix GT911 datasheet / mainline goodix.c */
+
+#define CTP_RST_HOLD_MS      20     /* T2: > 10ms with reset asserted     */
+#define CTP_ADDR_SETUP_US    100    /* T3: > 100us INT level before reset */
+#define CTP_RST_RELEASE_MS   10     /* T4: > 5ms after reset deasserted   */
+#define CTP_INT_SYNC_MS      50     /* T5: INT low pulse after reset      */
+
+/****************************************************************************
+ * Private Function Prototypes
+ ****************************************************************************/
+
+static int gt9xx_irq_attach(const struct gt9xx_board_s *state,
+                            xcpt_t isr, void *arg);
+static void gt9xx_irq_enable(const struct gt9xx_board_s *state, bool enable);
+static int gt9xx_set_power(const struct gt9xx_board_s *state, bool on);
+
+/****************************************************************************
+ * Private Data
+ ****************************************************************************/
+
+/* Callback for Board-Specific Operations */
+
+static const struct gt9xx_board_s g_vsai_logicpi_a1_gt9xx =
+{
+  .irq_attach = gt9xx_irq_attach,
+  .irq_enable = gt9xx_irq_enable,
+  .set_power  = gt9xx_set_power
+};
+
+/****************************************************************************
+ * Private Functions
+ ****************************************************************************/
+
+/****************************************************************************
+ * Name: gt911_reset
+ *
+ * Description:
+ *   Run the GT911 power-on reset sequence.  INT held low during reset
+ *   selects the 0x5d I2C address.
+ *
+ ****************************************************************************/
+
+static int gt911_reset(void)
+{
+  int ret;
+
+  ret = s6_gpioa_config_output(CTP_RST_PIN, false);
+  if (ret < 0)
+    {
+      return ret;
+    }
+
+  nxsched_usleep(CTP_RST_HOLD_MS * 1000);
+
+  ret = s6_gpioa_config_output(CTP_INT_PIN, false);
+  if (ret < 0)
+    {
+      return ret;
+    }
+
+  nxsched_usleep(CTP_ADDR_SETUP_US);
+
+  s6_gpioa_write(CTP_RST_PIN, true);
+  nxsched_usleep(CTP_RST_RELEASE_MS * 1000);
+
+  nxsched_usleep(CTP_INT_SYNC_MS * 1000);
+
+  return s6_gpioa_config_input(CTP_INT_PIN);
+}
+
+/****************************************************************************
+ * Name: gt9xx_irq_attach
+ *
+ * Description:
+ *   Attach the Touch Panel Interrupt Handler and arm the gpio_intc
+ *   channel for a falling edge on GPIOA_10.
+ *
+ ****************************************************************************/
+
+static int gt9xx_irq_attach(const struct gt9xx_board_s *state,
+                            xcpt_t isr, void *arg)
+{
+  int ret;
+
+  iinfo("\n");
+
+  ret = irq_attach(CTP_IRQ, isr, arg);
+  if (ret < 0)
+    {
+      ierr("irq_attach failed: %d\n", ret);
+      return ret;
+    }
+
+  /* A GPIO edge is converted by gpio_intc into a rising-edge pulse for the
+   * GIC.  This matches meson_gpio_irq_type_output() in the vendor SDK.
+   */
+
+  up_set_irq_type(CTP_IRQ, IRQ_RISING_EDGE);
+
+  ret = s6_gpioint_config(CTP_INT_CHANNEL, CTP_INT_GPIO,
+                          IRQ_FALLING_EDGE);
+  if (ret < 0)
+    {
+      irq_detach(CTP_IRQ);
+    }
+
+  return ret;
+}
+
+/****************************************************************************
+ * Name: gt9xx_irq_enable
+ *
+ * Description:
+ *   Enable or disable Touch Panel Interrupts at the GIC.
+ *
+ ****************************************************************************/
+
+static void gt9xx_irq_enable(const struct gt9xx_board_s *state, bool enable)
+{
+  iinfo("enable=%d\n", enable);
+
+  if (enable)
+    {
+      up_enable_irq(CTP_IRQ);
+    }
+  else
+    {
+      up_disable_irq(CTP_IRQ);
+    }
+}
+
+/****************************************************************************
+ * Name: gt9xx_set_power
+ *
+ * Description:
+ *   Power the Touch Panel up with the GT911 reset sequence, or leave it
+ *   running on close (holding reset would stop touch scanning).
+ *
+ ****************************************************************************/
+
+static int gt9xx_set_power(const struct gt9xx_board_s *state, bool on)
+{
+  iinfo("on=%d\n", on);
+
+  return on ? gt911_reset() : OK;
+}
+
+/****************************************************************************
+ * Public Functions
+ ****************************************************************************/
+
+/****************************************************************************
+ * Name: vsai_logicpi_a1_touch_register
+ *
+ * Description:
+ *   Register the GT911 Touch Panel on I2C0 as devpath (e.g. "/dev/input0").
+ *
+ * Input Parameters:
+ *   devpath - Device Path (e.g. "/dev/input0")
+ *   i2c     - I2C bus (as returned by s6_i2cbus_initialize())
+ *
+ * Returned Value:
+ *   Zero (OK) on success; a negated errno value is returned on any failure.
+ *
+ ****************************************************************************/
+
+int vsai_logicpi_a1_touch_register(FAR const char *devpath,
+                                   FAR struct i2c_master_s *i2c)
+{
+  int ret;
+
+  iinfo("devpath=%s\n", devpath);
+
+  /* Route I2C0 to GPIOA_0 (SDA) / GPIOA_1 (SCL), function 3 */
+
+  ret = s6_gpioa_set_mux(0, 3);
+  if (ret < 0)
+    {
+      ierr("SDA mux failed: %d\n", ret);
+      return ret;
+    }
+
+  ret = s6_gpioa_set_mux(1, 3);
+  if (ret < 0)
+    {
+      ierr("SCL mux failed: %d\n", ret);
+      return ret;
+    }
+
+  ret = gt9xx_register(devpath, i2c, CTP_I2C_ADDR, &g_vsai_logicpi_a1_gt9xx);
+  if (ret < 0)
+    {
+      ierr("gt9xx_register failed: %d\n", ret);
+    }
+
+  return ret;
+}

/****************************************************************************
 * arch/arm64/src/s6/hardware/s6_gpio.h
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 *
 ****************************************************************************/

#ifndef __ARCH_ARM64_SRC_S6_HARDWARE_S6_GPIO_H
#define __ARCH_ARM64_SRC_S6_HARDWARE_S6_GPIO_H

/****************************************************************************
 * Included Files
 ****************************************************************************/

#include <nuttx/config.h>

#include <arch/chip/chip.h>

/****************************************************************************
 * Pre-processor Definitions
 ****************************************************************************/

/* Periphs pinctrl / GPIO interrupt controller base addresses */

#define S6_GPIO_MUX_BASE          (CONFIG_DEVICEIO_BASEADDR + 0x4000)
#define S6_GPIO_INTC_BASE         (CONFIG_DEVICEIO_BASEADDR + 0x4080)
#define S6_GPIO_GPIO_BASE         (CONFIG_DEVICEIO_BASEADDR + 0x40c0)

/* GPIOA bank registers.  The pinctrl driver stores register indices that
 * are word-scaled on access ((index + bit / 32) * 4), so the offsets below
 * are the resulting physical offsets from S6_GPIO_GPIO_BASE:
 *   OUT = 0x071 * 4 = 0x1c4
 *   DIR = 0x072 * 4 = 0x1c8 (EN_N semantics: bit set is input)
 */

#define S6_GPIOA_OUT_OFFSET       0x1c4
#define S6_GPIOA_DIR_OFFSET       0x1c8

/* GPIOA pin mux: bank index 0x010, word-scaled on access (x4), four bits
 * per pin (16 pins span two words, 8 pins each).
 */

#define S6_GPIOA_MUX_OFFSET(pin)  (0x040 + ((pin) >> 3) * 4)
#define S6_GPIOA_MUX_SHIFT(pin)   (((pin) & 7) * 4)

/* GPIO interrupt controller (12 channels mapped to GIC SPI 10..21, i.e.
 * GIC INTIDs 42..53).  Channel selection register layout:
 *   PIN_SEL(channel)   select register for the GPIO number
 *   EDGE_POL           bit(0+n): polarity low, bit(12+n): edge,
 *                      bit31: global enable switch
 *   EDGE_POL_EXTR      bit(n): both-edges mode
 */

#define S6_GPIOINT_EDGE_POL_OFFSET      0x00
#define S6_GPIOINT_PIN_SEL_OFFSET(ch)   (0x04 + ((ch) >> 1) * 4)
#define S6_GPIOINT_EDGE_POL_EXTR_OFFSET 0x1c

#define S6_GPIOINT_GLOBAL_EN      (1u << 31)
#define S6_GPIOINT_POL_LOW(ch)    (1u << (ch))
#define S6_GPIOINT_EDGE(ch)       (1u << (12 + (ch)))
#define S6_GPIOINT_BOTH(ch)       (1u << (ch))

#define S6_GPIOINT_PIN_SEL_SHIFT(ch)  (((ch) & 1) * 16)
#define S6_GPIOINT_PIN_SEL_MASK(ch)   (0xffu << S6_GPIOINT_PIN_SEL_SHIFT(ch))

#endif /* __ARCH_ARM64_SRC_S6_HARDWARE_S6_GPIO_H */

/****************************************************************************
 * arch/arm64/src/s6/hardware/s6_i2c.h
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 *
 ****************************************************************************/

#ifndef __ARCH_ARM64_SRC_S6_HARDWARE_S6_I2C_H
#define __ARCH_ARM64_SRC_S6_HARDWARE_S6_I2C_H

/****************************************************************************
 * Included Files
 ****************************************************************************/

#include <nuttx/config.h>

#include <arch/chip/chip.h>

/****************************************************************************
 * Public Types
 ****************************************************************************/

/* I2C token commands, four bits each, packed into the token list
 * registers (up to 8 tokens per register).
 */

enum s6_i2c_token_e
{
  S6_I2C_TOKEN_END              = 0,
  S6_I2C_TOKEN_START            = 1,
  S6_I2C_TOKEN_SLAVE_ADDR_WRITE = 2,
  S6_I2C_TOKEN_SLAVE_ADDR_READ  = 3,
  S6_I2C_TOKEN_DATA             = 4,
  S6_I2C_TOKEN_DATA_LAST        = 5,
  S6_I2C_TOKEN_STOP             = 6,
};

/****************************************************************************
 * Pre-processor Definitions
 ****************************************************************************/

/* Register offsets (relative to the controller base address) */

#define S6_I2C_CTRL_OFFSET        0x00
#define S6_I2C_SLAVE_ADDR_OFFSET  0x04
#define S6_I2C_TOK_LIST0_OFFSET   0x08
#define S6_I2C_TOK_LIST1_OFFSET   0x0c
#define S6_I2C_TOK_WDATA0_OFFSET  0x10
#define S6_I2C_TOK_WDATA1_OFFSET  0x14
#define S6_I2C_TOK_RDATA0_OFFSET  0x18
#define S6_I2C_TOK_RDATA1_OFFSET  0x1c

/* CTRL register fields */

#define S6_I2C_CTRL_START         (1u << 0)
#define S6_I2C_CTRL_ACK_IGNORE    (1u << 1)
#define S6_I2C_CTRL_STATUS        (1u << 2)
#define S6_I2C_CTRL_ERROR         (1u << 3)
#define S6_I2C_CTRL_SCL_LEVEL     (1u << 25)
#define S6_I2C_CTRL_SDA_LEVEL     (1u << 26)
#define S6_I2C_CTRL_CLKDIV_SHIFT  12
#define S6_I2C_CTRL_CLKDIV_MASK   (0x3ffu << S6_I2C_CTRL_CLKDIV_SHIFT)
#define S6_I2C_CTRL_CLKDIVEXT_SHIFT 28
#define S6_I2C_CTRL_CLKDIVEXT_MASK  (0x3u << S6_I2C_CTRL_CLKDIVEXT_SHIFT)

/* SLAVE_ADDR register fields.  Bits [7:0] hold the slave address (addr << 1)
 * while bits [27:16] hold the SCL low time divisor and bit 28 enables it,
 * so every access must use masking.
 */

#define S6_I2C_SLV_ADDR_MASK      0xffu
#define S6_I2C_SLV_DIVL_SHIFT     16
#define S6_I2C_SLV_DIVL_MASK      (0xfffu << S6_I2C_SLV_DIVL_SHIFT)
#define S6_I2C_SLV_DIVL_EN        (1u << 28)

/* SYS_CLK_EN0_REG1 gate bits.  sys_i2c_m_a is the parent of all the
 * master gates and must be on for any of them to run.
 */

#define S6_CLK_SYS_CLK_EN0_REG1   (CONFIG_DEVICEIO_BASEADDR + 0x48)
#define S6_I2C_GATE               (1u << 30)

#endif /* __ARCH_ARM64_SRC_S6_HARDWARE_S6_I2C_H */

import sys, re

BOILER_START = 'Licensed to the Apache'
BOILER_END = 'limitations under the License'

def strip_file(path):
    with open(path) as f:
        lines = f.read().split('\n')
    # only consider the header: first 30 lines
    head = lines[:30]
    try:
        s = next(i for i,l in enumerate(head) if BOILER_START in l)
        e = next(i for i,l in enumerate(head) if BOILER_END in l)
    except StopIteration:
        return False
    e2 = e + 1
    if e2 < len(head) and re.match(r'^\s*(\*|#)\s*$', lines[e2]):
        e2_skip = 1
    else:
        e2_skip = 0
    # drop lines s..e plus optional filler after
    new_head = head[:s] + head[e+1+e2_skip:]
    with open(path,'w') as f:
        f.write('\n'.join(new_head + lines[30:]))
    return True

for p in sys.argv[1:]:
    strip_file(p)

# contest2026_349_board（VSAI LogicPi A1）

映射到 openvela `vendor/openvela/boards/contest2026_349_board`，为
VSAI LogicPi A1（Amlogic Meson S6，Cortex-A55，GICv3）提供板级适配。

## 分仓说明

本仓只包含**板级**适配（构建配置、链接脚本、板级初始化、GT911 触摸等）。
**芯片级**支持（`arch/arm64/src/s6`、`arch/arm64/include/s6`）在独立的
nuttx 分仓，本项目必须配合它编译：

- <https://github.com/U2FsdGVkX1/vela-nuttx>（`dev-ai-contest-2026` 分支，
  基于 `open-vela/nuttx` 同名分支叠加 s6 芯片提交）

`repo sync` 得到的 `nuttx/` 不含 s6 支持，编译前需把工作区 `nuttx/`
切换到上述分仓：

```bash
cd <openvela 工作区>/nuttx
git remote add fork https://github.com/U2FsdGVkX1/vela-nuttx.git
git fetch fork dev-ai-contest-2026
git checkout -B dev-ai-contest-2026 FETCH_HEAD
```

## 硬件要点

- DDR/时钟/pinmux/显示通路由 BL31/U-Boot 初始化，NuttX 从 `0x03080000`
  启动（U-Boot `booti` 重定位后的地址），控制台为 UART0（UART-B）921600。
- MIPI DSI 复用 U-Boot 点亮的 OSD1（1080x1920 RGB565，单缓冲，
  `updatearea` 刷缓存）；GT911 触摸接 I2C0（GPIOA_0/1），中断 GPIOA_10。

## 构建

defconfig 走自定义板机制（`ARCH_BOARD_CUSTOM`），在 openvela 工作区
根目录执行：

```bash

./build.sh vendor/openvela/boards/contest2026_349_board/configs/lvgl -j   # LVGL 演示（显示 + 触摸）
```

部署：U-Boot 将 `nuttx.bin` 读到 `0x03080000` 后 `booti`；LVGL 演示在
NSH 下执行 `lvgldemo widgets`。
